description: Jangada Orbital is a team from Fortaleza, Ceará, Brazil, taking on the Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. We are a full-stack developer who works with telemetry and large datasets, two Telecommunications Engineering students from IFCE (one also at the Apple Developer Academy) and a Huawei ICT Academy hackathon veteran. Our goal: turn two decades of NASA fire data into one consistent fire calendar that emergency teams can trust. Team complete (3 members).
